تستكثروا (form X)
# تَسْتَكْثِرُوا (tastakṯirū) /tas.tak.θi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# تُسْتَكْثَرُوا (tustakṯarū) /tus.tak.θa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
